from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
from langgraph.graph.state import CompiledStateGraph
from knowledge_util import search_util, llm_util, hash_id, get_json_dict_res, PromptFactory, FileManager, ProcessStage, TreeNode

class KnowledgeTreeState(TypedDict):
    """知识树构建系统的状态定义"""
    # 输入参数
    long_text: str
    source_name: str
    field: str
    source_url: str
    recursive_times: int
    
    # 处理中间状态
    current_stage: ProcessStage
    chunks: List[Dict[str, str]]  # [{"id": "001", "text": "..."}]
    numbered_text: str
    base_tree: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    rich_tree: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    final_tree: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    
    # Rich阶段特定状态
    current_recursive_level: int
    leaf_nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    search_results: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    reports: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    sub_trees: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    
    # Postprocess阶段状态
    simplified_tree: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    beautified_tree: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    
    # 错误和日志
    errors: List[str]
    logs: List[str]
    
    # ReAct循环控制
    react_iteration: int
    max_react_iterations: int
    current_feedback: str



class KnowledgeTreeBuilder:
    """知识树构建器主类"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        """
        初始化知识树构建器
        
        Args:
            config: 配置字典，包含各种参数设置
        """
        self.config = config or {}
        self.prompt_factory = PromptFactory()
        self.file_manager = FileManager()
        self.graph = self._build_graph()
        
        logger.info("知识树构建器初始化完成")
    
    def _build_graph(self) -> CompiledStateGraph:
        """
        构建LangGraph状态图
        
        Returns:
            编译后的状态图
        """
        workflow = StateGraph(KnowledgeTreeState)
        
        # 添加节点
        workflow.add_node("text_chunking", self.text_chunking_node)
        workflow.add_node("base_tree_generator", self.base_tree_generator_node)
        workflow.add_node("base_tree_checker", self.base_tree_checker_node)
        workflow.add_node("base_tree_improver", self.base_tree_improver_node)
        workflow.add_node("reference_mapper", self.reference_mapper_node)
        workflow.add_node("path_generator", self.path_generator_node)
        workflow.add_node("node_id_assigner", self.node_id_assigner_node)
        workflow.add_node("source_info_adder", self.source_info_adder_node)
        
        # Rich阶段节点
        workflow.add_node("leaf_nodes_extractor", self.leaf_nodes_extractor_node)
        workflow.add_node("search_query_generator", self.search_query_generator_node)
        workflow.add_node("search_executor", self.search_executor_node)
        workflow.add_node("search_result_cleaner", self.search_result_cleaner_node)
        workflow.add_node("report_generator", self.report_generator_node)
        workflow.add_node("report_checker", self.report_checker_node)
        workflow.add_node("report_improver", self.report_improver_node)
        workflow.add_node("sub_tree_builder", self.sub_tree_builder_node)
        workflow.add_node("tree_integrator", self.tree_integrator_node)
        
        # Postprocess阶段节点

        workflow.add_node("labels_relations_designer", self.labels_relations_designer_node)
        workflow.add_node("structure_validator", self.structure_validator_node)
        workflow.add_node("alias_description_generator", self.alias_description_generator_node)

        # 设置边（控制流）

        workflow.add_edge("base_tree_generator", "base_tree_checker")
        workflow.add_conditional_edges(

            }

        workflow.add_edge("search_query_generator", "search_executor")
        workflow.add_edge("search_executor", "search_result_cleaner")
        workflow.add_edge("search_result_cleaner", "report_generator")
        workflow.add_edge("report_generator", "report_checker")
        workflow.add_conditional_edges(
            "report_checker",
            self.check_report_condition,
            {
                "improve": "report_improver",
                "continue": "sub_tree_builder"
            }
        )
        workflow.add_edge("report_improver", "report_checker")
        workflow.add_edge("sub_tree_builder", "tree_integrator")
        workflow.add_conditional_edges(
            "tree_integrator",
            self.check_recursive_condition,
            {
                "continue": "leaf_nodes_extractor",
                "postprocess": "tree_simplifier"
            }
        )
        
        # Postprocess阶段流程
        workflow.add_edge("tree_simplifier", "labels_relations_designer")
        workflow.add_edge("labels_relations_designer", "structure_validator")
        workflow.add_conditional_edges(
            "structure_validator",
            self.check_structure_condition,
            {
                "fix": "labels_relations_designer",
                "continue": "alias_description_generator"
            }
        )
        workflow.add_edge("alias_description_generator", "final_tree_assembler")
        workflow.add_edge("final_tree_assembler", END)
        
        return workflow.compile()
    
    # ==================== Preprocess阶段节点 ====================
    
    def text_chunking_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        文本分块节点
        
        将长文本按照双换行符分割，清理并编号
        """
        logger.info("开始文本分块处理")
        
        chunks = state["long_text"].split("\n\n")
        cleaned_chunks = []
        
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks, 1):
            cleaned_chunk = chunk.strip()
            if cleaned_chunk:
                chunk_id = f"{i:03d}"
                cleaned_chunks.append({
                    "id": chunk_id,
                    "text": cleaned_chunk
                })
        
        # 创建编号文本
        numbered_text = "\n".join([f"[{c['id']}] {c['text']}" for c in cleaned_chunks])
        
        logger.info(f"文本分块完成，共{len(cleaned_chunks)}个块")
        
        return {
            "chunks": cleaned_chunks,
            "numbered_text": numbered_text,
            "current_stage": ProcessStage.PREPROCESS
        }
    
    def base_tree_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """基础树生成节点"""
        logger.info("开始生成基础树")
        
        prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_base_tree_prompt(
            field=state["field"],
            numbered_text=state["numbered_text"]
        )
        
        response = llm_util(prompt, model="gpt-4o")
        
        try:
            base_tree = get_json_dict_res(response)
            logger.info("基础树生成成功")
            self.file_manager.save_tree(base_tree, "init_base_tree", state["field"])
            return {
                "base_tree": base_tree,
                "react_iteration": 0
            }
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.error(f"基础树JSON解析失败: {e}")
            return {
                "base_tree": None,
                "errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"JSON解析失败: {e}"],
                "react_iteration": 0
            }
    
    def base_tree_checker_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """基础树检查节点"""
        logger.info("检查基础树质量")
        
        if state["base_tree"] is None:
            return {"current_feedback": "基础树为空，需要重新生成"}
        
        prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_check_base_tree_prompt(state["base_tree"])
        response = llm_util(prompt)
        feedback = get_json_dict_res(response)
        
        return {
            "current_feedback": feedback,
            "react_iteration": state["react_iteration"] + 1
        }
    
    def base_tree_improver_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """基础树改进节点"""
        logger.info(f"改进基础树，第{state['react_iteration']}次迭代")
        
        prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_improve_with_feedback_prompt(
            tree=state["base_tree"],
            feedback=state["current_feedback"]
        )
        
        response = llm_util(prompt)
        
        try:
            improved_tree = get_json_dict_res(response)
            logger.info("改进成功")
            self.file_manager.save_tree(improved_tree, f"improved_tree_{state['react_iteration']}", state["field"])
            return {"base_tree": improved_tree}
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.error(f"改进的树JSON解析失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"改进失败: {e}"]}
    
    def reference_mapper_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """引用映射节点"""
        logger.info("映射引用到文本内容")
        
        def map_references(node: Dict[str, Any], chunks: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归映射引用"""
            if "reference_id_list" in node:
                # 获取对应的文本块
                referenced_texts = []
                for ref_id in node.get("reference_id_list", []):
                    for chunk in chunks:
                        if chunk["id"] == ref_id:
                            referenced_texts.append(chunk["text"])
                            break
                
                # 添加reference字段，移除reference_id_list
                node["reference"] = "\n".join(referenced_texts)
                del node["reference_id_list"]
            
            # 递归处理子节点
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    map_references(child, chunks) 
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        mapped_tree = map_references(state["base_tree"].copy(), state["chunks"])
        
        return {"base_tree": mapped_tree}
    
    def path_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """路径生成节点"""
        logger.info("生成节点路径")
        
        def add_paths(node: Dict[str, Any], parent_path: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归添加路径"""
            current_path = f"{parent_path}->{node['title']}" if parent_path else node["title"]
            node["path"] = current_path
            
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    add_paths(child, current_path) 
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        tree_with_paths = add_paths(state["base_tree"].copy())
        
        return {"base_tree": tree_with_paths}
    
    def node_id_assigner_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """节点ID分配节点"""
        logger.info("分配节点ID")
        
        def add_node_ids(node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归添加节点ID"""
            node["node_id"] = hash_id(node["title"] + node["path"])
            
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    add_node_ids(child) 
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        tree_with_ids = add_node_ids(state["base_tree"].copy())
        
        return {"base_tree": tree_with_ids}
    
    def source_info_adder_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """源信息添加节点"""
        logger.info("添加源信息")
        
        def add_source_info(node: Dict[str, Any], source_info: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归添加源信息"""
            node["source"] = source_info.copy()
            node["source"]["source_content"] = node.get("reference", "")
            
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    add_source_info(child, source_info) 
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        source_info = {
            "source_name": state["source_name"],
            "source_url": state["source_url"]
        }
        
        tree_with_source = add_source_info(state["base_tree"].copy(), source_info)
        
        # 保存基础树到文件
        self.file_manager.save_tree(tree_with_source, "base_tree", state["field"])
        
        return {"base_tree": tree_with_source}
    
    # ==================== Rich阶段节点 ====================
    
    def leaf_nodes_extractor_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """叶子节点提取器"""
        logger.info("提取叶子节点")
        
        def extract_leaf_nodes(node: Dict[str, Any], leaves: List[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
            """递归提取叶子节点"""
            if leaves is None:
                leaves = []
            
            if "children" not in node or len(node["children"]) == 0:
                leaves.append(node)
            else:
                for child in node["children"]:
                    extract_leaf_nodes(child, leaves)
            
            return leaves
        
        current_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
        leaf_nodes = extract_leaf_nodes(current_tree)
        
        logger.info(f"提取到{len(leaf_nodes)}个叶子节点")
        
        return {
            "leaf_nodes": leaf_nodes,
            "current_stage": ProcessStage.RICH
        }
    
    async def search_query_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """搜索查询生成器（异步）"""
        logger.info("生成搜索查询")
        
        async def generate_query(leaf_node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """为单个叶子节点生成查询"""
            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_search_query_prompt(
                field=state["field"],
                path=leaf_node["path"],
                leaf_node=leaf_node["title"]
            )
            
            response = await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)
            
            query = get_json_dict_res(response).get("search_query", leaf_node["path"]).strip()
            
            return {
                "node": leaf_node,
                "search_query": query
            }
        
        # 异步生成所有查询
        tasks = [generate_query(node) for node in state["leaf_nodes"]]
        query_results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        
        # 更新叶子节点的search_query
        for result in query_results:
            result["node"]["search_query"] = result["search_query"]
        
        return {"leaf_nodes": state["leaf_nodes"]}
    
    async def search_executor_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """搜索执行器（异步）"""
        logger.info("执行搜索")
        
        async def execute_search(leaf_node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """执行单个搜索"""
            search_results = await asyncio.to_thread(
                search_util, 
                leaf_node["search_query"]
            )
            
            # 保存搜索结果
            self.file_manager.save_search_results(
                search_results,
                state["field"],
                leaf_node["title"],
                leaf_node["node_id"]
            )
            
            return {
                "node": leaf_node,
                "results": search_results
            }
        
        # 异步执行所有搜索
        tasks = [execute_search(node) for node in state["leaf_nodes"]]
        search_results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        
        return {"search_results": search_results}


    async def search_result_cleaner_node(self, state: "KnowledgeTreeState") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """搜索结果清洗器（异步并发版）"""
        logger.info("清洗搜索结果（异步）")

        # 并发上限，可在实例上设置 self.max_concurrency；没有则默认 8
        max_concurrency = getattr(self, "max_concurrency", 8)
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)

        async def _clean_one(i: int, j: int, node: Dict[str, Any], single_result: Any) -> Tuple[int, int, str]:
            """清洗单条搜索结果，返回 (node_idx, result_idx, cleaned_text)"""
            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_clean_search_result_prompt(
                search_results=single_result,
                field=state["field"],
                path=node["path"],
                leaf_node=node["title"]
            )
            try:
                # 将可能阻塞的 LLM 调用丢到线程池，避免卡住事件循环
                response = await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)
                cleaned = (response or "").strip()
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(f"清洗搜索结果出错 node={node.get('title')} at ({i}, {j})")
                cleaned = ""
            return i, j, cleaned

        async def _sem_task(i: int, j: int, node: Dict[str, Any], single_result: Any):
            """带 Semaphore 的包装，控制并发"""
            async with sem:
                return await _clean_one(i, j, node, single_result)

        # 构建所有任务：对每个 node 的每条 result 并发清洗
        tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        for i, result_data in enumerate(state["search_results"]):
            node = result_data["node"]
            for j, single_result in enumerate(result_data.get("results", [])):
                tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(_sem_task(i, j, node, single_result)))

        # 并发执行并收集结果
        cleaned_tuples: List[Tuple[int, int, str]] = []
        if tasks:
            cleaned_tuples = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        else:
            logger.info("没有可清洗的搜索结果")

        # 组装回每个节点（按 j 排序，保持原顺序）
        grouped: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, str]]] = {}
        for i, j, text in cleaned_tuples:
            grouped.setdefault(i, []).append((j, text))

        cleaned_results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for i, result_data in enumerate(state["search_results"]):
            node = result_data["node"]
            parts = [text for _, text in sorted(grouped.get(i, []), key=lambda x: x[0]) if text]
            cleaned_content = "\n\n".join(parts)
            cleaned_results.append({
                "node": node,
                "cleaned_content": cleaned_content
            })

        return {"search_results": cleaned_results}

    async def report_generator_node(self, state: "KnowledgeTreeState") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        报告生成器（异步 / 分块 / 并发 / 缓存 / 容错）
        输入：state["search_results"] = [
            {"node": {...}, "cleaned_content": "..."},
            ...
        ]
        输出：{"reports": [{"node":..., "report": str, "report_path": str, ...}, ...]}
        """
        logger.info("生成研究报告（异步增强版）")

        # ---- 可配置参数（可在实例上覆盖） ----
        max_concurrency: int = getattr(self, "max_concurrency", 8)                 # 全局并发
        chunk_chars: int = getattr(self, "report_chunk_chars", 10000)               # 分块大小（字符）
        chunk_overlap: int = getattr(self, "report_chunk_overlap", 400)            # 分块重叠（字符）
        enable_cache: bool = getattr(self, "enable_report_cache", True)            # 启用缓存
        save_partials: bool = getattr(self, "save_intermediate_reports", False)    # 是否保存子报告
        level_default: int = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)

        # 简单实例级缓存： key=(node_id, sha256(cleaned_content)) -> (report, path)
        if not hasattr(self, "_report_cache"):
            self._report_cache: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Tuple[str, Optional[str]]] = {}

        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)

        def _split_chunks(text: str, size: int, overlap: int) -> List[str]:
            """按字符窗口分块，带重叠；保留顺序。"""
            text = text or ""
            n = len(text)
            if n <= size or size <= 0:
                return [text] if text else []
            chunks = []
            start = 0
            while start < n:
                end = min(n, start + size)
                chunks.append(text[start:end])
                if end >= n:
                    break
                # 下一块从 end-overlap 开始，确保有重叠
                start = max(0, end - max(0, overlap))
            return chunks

        async def _llm_call(prompt: str) -> str:
            """将潜在阻塞的 llm_util 放入线程池，避免阻塞事件循环。"""
            try:
                return (await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)) or ""
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("LLM 调用异常")
                return ""

        async def _map_chunk(node: Dict[str, Any], chunk_text: str) -> str:
            """对子块生成子报告（map阶段）"""
            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_research_result_to_report_prompt(
                cleaned_content=chunk_text,
                field=state["field"],
                path=node["path"],
                leaf_node=node["title"]
            )
            return await _llm_call(prompt)

        async def _reduce_reports(node: Dict[str, Any], partials: List[str]) -> str:
            """合并子报告为最终报告（reduce阶段）；优先使用 prompt_factory 的综合提示词。"""
            # 去掉空块，避免噪声
            partials = [p.strip() for p in partials if p and p.strip()]
            if not partials:
                return ""

            synth_prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_report_synthesis_prompt(
                partial_reports=partials,
                field=state["field"],
                path=node["path"],
                leaf_node=node["title"]
            )
            return await _llm_call(synth_prompt)

        async def _build_report_for_node(idx: int, result_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """处理单个节点：缓存命中 -> 直接返回；否则分块生成 -> 合并 -> 存盘"""
            node: Dict[str, Any] = result_data["node"]
            content: str = (result_data.get("cleaned_content") or "").strip()
            node_id: str = str(node.get("node_id", f"node_{idx}"))
            title: str = str(node.get("title", f"Leaf_{idx}"))

            if not content:
                logger.warning(f"[report] 节点({title})内容为空，跳过生成")
                return {"node": node, "report": "", "report_path": None, "error": "EMPTY_CONTENT"}

            content_hash = hash_id(content)
            cache_key = (node_id, content_hash)

            # 命中缓存
            if enable_cache and cache_key in self._report_cache:
                cached_report, cached_path = self._report_cache[cache_key]
                return {
                    "node": node,
                    "report": cached_report,
                    "report_path": cached_path,
                    "content_hash": content_hash,
                    "source_size": len(content),
                    "cache_hit": True,
                }

            # 未命中：开始生成
            try:
                async with sem:
                    # --- 分块 ---
                    chunks = _split_chunks(content, chunk_chars, chunk_overlap)
                    # 短文本：直接一次成文
                    if len(chunks) <= 1:
                        prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_research_result_to_report_prompt(
                            cleaned_content=content,
                            field=state["field"],
                            path=node["path"],
                            leaf_node=title
                        )
                        report = await _llm_call(prompt)
                    else:
                        # Map：对子块并发生成子报告（每个子块再受全局 sem 控制）
                        map_tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_map_chunk(node, c)) for c in chunks]
                        partials: List[str] = await asyncio.gather(*map_tasks)
                        # 可选：保存子报告，便于回溯
                        if save_partials:
                            try:
                                for k, pr in enumerate(partials):
                                    await asyncio.to_thread(
                                        self.file_manager.save_report,
                                        pr, f"{title}__partial_{k+1}_of_{len(partials)}",
                                        node_id, level_default
                                    )
                            except Exception:
                                logger.exception(f"[report] 保存子报告失败（node={title})")
                        # Reduce：综合子报告为最终报告
                        report = await _reduce_reports(node, partials)

                    # 存盘
                    report_path = await asyncio.to_thread(
                        self.file_manager.save_report, report, title, node_id, level_default
                    )

                    # 写入缓存
                    if enable_cache:
                        self._report_cache[cache_key] = (report, report_path)

                    return {
                        "node": node,
                        "report": report,
                        "report_path": report_path,
                        "content_hash": content_hash,
                        "source_size": len(content),
                        "cache_hit": False,
                    }

            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(f"[report] 生成失败：node={title}")
                return {"node": node, "report": "", "report_path": None, "error": str(e)}

        # ---------- 并发处理所有节点 ----------
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_build_report_for_node(i, rd))
                for i, rd in enumerate(state.get("search_results", []))]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if tasks else []

        # 保序（enumerate 顺序即原始顺序），直接返回
        return {"reports": results}

    async def report_checker_node(self, state: "KnowledgeTreeState") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        报告检查器（异步并发版）
        返回：
          {
            "current_feedback": "[{node_id,title,feedback}, ...]"  # 注意：始终为 JSON 列表字符串
            "report_check_status": "PASS" | "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
            "report_check_summary": {...}   # 便于监控/日志
          }
        """
        logger.info("检查报告质量（异步）")

        max_concurrency: int = getattr(self, "max_concurrency", 8)
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)

        reports: List[Dict[str, Any]] = state.get("reports", []) or []

        async def _llm_call(prompt: str) -> str:
            try:
                return (await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)) or ""
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("LLM 调用异常（检查报告）")
                return ""

        def _normalize_feedback(raw: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """尝试解析与规范化反馈结构，确保含 status 字段。"""
            if isinstance(raw, dict):
                fb = raw
            else:
                try:
                    fb = get_json_dict_res(raw)  # 可容忍非严格 JSON 的解析函数
                    if not isinstance(fb, dict):
                        fb = {}
                except Exception:
                    fb = {}
            status = str(fb.get("status", "FAILED")).upper()
            if status not in ("PASS", "FAILED"):
                # 有些模型会输出 'FAIL', 'NOT_PASS', 'NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT'，统一映射为 FAILED
                if "PASS" in status:
                    status = "PASS"
                else:
                    status = "FAILED"
            fb["status"] = status
            return fb

        async def _check_one(report_idx: int, rd: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            node = rd.get("node", {}) or {}
            title = str(node.get("title", f"Leaf_{report_idx}"))
            node_id = str(node.get("node_id", f"node_{report_idx}"))
            report_text = (rd.get("report") or "").strip()

            if not report_text:
                # 空报告直接视为失败并返回原因
                feedback = {
                    "status": "FAILED",
                    "issues": ["EMPTY_REPORT"],
                    "message": "报告内容为空"
                }
                return {"node_id": node_id, "title": title, "feedback": feedback}

            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_check_report_prompt(report_text)
            try:
                async with sem:
                    resp = await _llm_call(prompt)
                feedback = _normalize_feedback(resp)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(f"检查报告失败：{title}")
                feedback = {"status": "FAILED", "issues": ["EXCEPTION"]}

            return {"node_id": node_id, "title": title, "feedback": feedback}

        # 并发检查
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_check_one(i, rd)) for i, rd in enumerate(reports)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if tasks else []

        # 汇总与筛选不通过的项
        failed_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        pass_cnt = 0
        for item in results:
            status = item["feedback"].get("status", "FAILED")
            if status == "PASS":
                pass_cnt += 1
            else:
                failed_items.append({
                    "node_id": item["node_id"],
                    "node": item["title"],           # 兼容旧字段名
                    "feedback": item["feedback"]
                })

        total = len(results)
        fail_cnt = total - pass_cnt

        # 始终返回 JSON 列表字符串，避免后续解析歧义
        current_feedback_json = json.dumps(failed_items, ensure_ascii=False)

        return {
            "current_feedback": current_feedback_json,
            "report_check_status": "PASS" if fail_cnt == 0 else "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
            "report_check_summary": {
                "total": total,
                "pass": pass_cnt,
                "fail": fail_cnt
            }
        }


    async def report_improver_node(self, state: "KnowledgeTreeState") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        报告改进器（异步并发版，支持可选自动复检）
        读入：
          - state["reports"]
          - state["current_feedback"]  # 期望为 JSON 列表字符串；亦兼容 "PASS"/空/非列表
        返回：
          {
            "reports": [...],                           # 按原顺序更新
            "improvement_summary": {...},               # 改进统计
            "residual_feedback_after_improve": "...",   # 若开启复检，返回残留问题列表(JSON字符串)，否则为空列表"[]"
          }
        """
        logger.info("改进报告（异步）")

        max_concurrency: int = getattr(self, "max_concurrency", 8)
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        level_default: int = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
        recheck: bool = getattr(self, "recheck_after_improve", True)

        reports: List[Dict[str, Any]] = state.get("reports", []) or []
        # 深拷贝列表骨架（内部 dict 可原位更新）
        improved_reports: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [dict(r) for r in reports]

        # ---- 解析反馈 ----
        raw_fb = state.get("current_feedback", "[]")
        feedback_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        def _safe_parse_feedback(raw: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
            if isinstance(raw, list):
                return raw
            if isinstance(raw, dict):
                # 若是 dict，则尝试视为单条
                return [raw]
            if isinstance(raw, str):
                rs = raw.strip()
                if not rs or rs.upper() == "PASS":
                    return []
                try:
                    obj = get_json_dict_res(rs)
                    if isinstance(obj, list):
                        return obj
                    if isinstance(obj, dict):
                        return [obj]
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        obj = json.loads(rs)
                        if isinstance(obj, list):
                            return obj
                        if isinstance(obj, dict):
                            return [obj]
                    except Exception:
                        logger.warning("current_feedback 解析失败，忽略并视为无反馈")
                        return []
            return []

        feedback_list = _safe_parse_feedback(raw_fb)

        # 映射到 {node_id or title -> feedback}
        fb_by_key: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in feedback_list:
            node_title = str(item.get("node") or item.get("title") or "")
            node_id = str(item.get("node_id") or "")
            key = node_id or node_title
            if key:
                fb_by_key[key] = item.get("feedback", {}) or {}

        if not fb_by_key:
            # 无需改进，原样返回
            return {
                "reports": improved_reports,
                "improvement_summary": {"total": len(reports), "improved": 0, "skipped": len(reports)},
                "residual_feedback_after_improve": "[]"
            }

        async def _llm_call(prompt: str) -> str:
            try:
                return (await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)) or ""
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("LLM 调用异常（改进报告）")
                return ""

        async def _improve_one(idx: int, rd: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[int, Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
            """
            改进单个报告。
            返回：(index, improved_text or None, error or None)
            """
            node = rd.get("node", {}) or {}
            title = str(node.get("title", f"Leaf_{idx}"))
            node_id = str(node.get("node_id", f"node_{idx}"))
            key = node_id or title

            if key not in fb_by_key:
                return idx, None, None  # 不需要改进

            feedback = fb_by_key[key]
            report_text = (rd.get("report") or "").strip()
            if not report_text:
                return idx, None, "EMPTY_REPORT"

            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_improve_report_prompt(report_text, feedback)

            try:
                async with sem:
                    improved = await _llm_call(prompt)
                improved = improved.strip() if improved else ""
                if not improved:
                    # 模型返回空，使用原文回退并标记错误
                    return idx, None, "EMPTY_MODEL_OUTPUT"

                # 保存更新（线程池执行）
                try:
                    _ = await asyncio.to_thread(
                        self.file_manager.save_report,
                        improved,
                        title,
                        node_id,
                        level_default
                    )
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception(f"保存改进报告失败：{title}")

                return idx, improved, None

            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(f"改进失败：{title}")
                return idx, None, str(e)

        # 并发改进
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_improve_one(i, rd)) for i, rd in enumerate(improved_reports)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if tasks else []

        improved_cnt = 0
        skipped_cnt = 0
        error_cnt = 0

        for idx, improved_text, err in results:
            if err:
                error_cnt += 1
                continue
            if improved_text is None:
                skipped_cnt += 1
                continue
            # 原位更新
            improved_reports[idx]["report"] = improved_text
            improved_cnt += 1

        residual_feedback_json = "[]"

        # 可选：对已改进项做一次快速复检，仅收集残留问题
        if recheck and improved_cnt > 0:
            try:
                # 只复检刚刚被改进的报告，减少开销
                recheck_targets = [
                    improved_reports[idx]
                    for idx, improved_text, err in results
                    if (improved_text is not None and not err)
                ]

                async def _recheck_one(rd: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                    node = rd.get("node", {}) or {}
                    title = str(node.get("title", ""))
                    node_id = str(node.get("node_id", ""))
                    prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_check_report_prompt(rd.get("report", ""))
                    resp = await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)
                    fb = get_json_dict_res(resp)
                    status = str(fb.get("status", "FAILED")).upper()
                    if status not in ("PASS",):
                        return {"node_id": node_id, "node": title, "feedback": fb}
                    return {}

                re_tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_recheck_one(rd)) for rd in recheck_targets]
                re_results = await asyncio.gather(*re_tasks) if re_tasks else []
                residual = [x for x in re_results if x]  # 过滤空 dict
                residual_feedback_json = json.dumps(residual, ensure_ascii=False)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("改进后复检出现异常")

        return {
            "reports": improved_reports,
            "improvement_summary": {
                "total": len(reports),
                "improved": improved_cnt,
                "skipped": skipped_cnt,
                "errors": error_cnt
            },
            "residual_feedback_after_improve": residual_feedback_json
        }
        
    def sub_tree_builder_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """子树构建器"""
        logger.info("为叶子节点构建子树")
        
        sub_trees = []
        
        for report_data in state["reports"]:
            node = report_data["node"]
            report = report_data["report"]
            
            # 使用报告内容生成子树
            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_base_tree_prompt(
                field=state["field"],
                numbered_text=report  # 使用报告作为输入
            )
            
            response = llm_util(prompt)
            
            try:
                sub_tree = get_json_dict_res(response)
                
                # 处理子树：添加路径、ID、源信息等
                sub_tree = self._process_sub_tree(sub_tree, node, report_data["report_path"])
                
                sub_trees.append({
                    "parent_node": node,
                    "sub_tree": sub_tree
                })
                
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                logger.error(f"子树JSON解析失败: {e}")
        
        return {"sub_trees": sub_trees}
    
    def _process_sub_tree(self, sub_tree: Dict[str, Any], parent_node: Dict[str, Any], report_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """处理子树：添加必要的信息"""
        
        def process_node(node: Dict[str, Any], parent_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            # 添加路径
            node["path"] = f"{parent_path}->{node['title']}"
            
            # 添加节点ID
            node["node_id"] = hash_id(node["title"] + node["path"])
            
            # 添加源信息
            node["source"] = {
                "source_name": parent_node.get("source", {}).get("source_name", ""),
                "source_url": report_path,
                "source_content": node.get("reference", "")
            }
            
            # 添加搜索查询（如果是通过研究生成的）
            node["search_query"] = parent_node.get("search_query", "")
            
            # 递归处理子节点
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    process_node(child, node["path"])
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        return process_node(sub_tree, parent_node["path"])
    
    def tree_integrator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """树集成器"""
        logger.info("集成子树到主树")
        
        current_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
        
        def integrate_sub_trees(node: Dict[str, Any], sub_trees_map: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归集成子树"""
            node_key = f"{node['title']}_{node['node_id']}"
            
            # 如果当前节点有对应的子树，添加其子节点
            if node_key in sub_trees_map:
                sub_tree = sub_trees_map[node_key]
                if "children" in sub_tree:
                    node["children"] = sub_tree["children"]
            
            # 递归处理原有子节点
            elif "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    integrate_sub_trees(child, sub_trees_map)
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        # 创建子树映射
        sub_trees_map = {}
        for sub_tree_data in state["sub_trees"]:
            parent = sub_tree_data["parent_node"]
            key = f"{parent['title']}_{parent['node_id']}"
            sub_trees_map[key] = sub_tree_data["sub_tree"]
        
        # 集成子树
        integrated_tree = integrate_sub_trees(current_tree.copy(), sub_trees_map)
        
        # 保存富化树
        level = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
        self.file_manager.save_tree(integrated_tree, f"rich_tree_level_{level}", state["field"])
        
        return {
            "rich_tree": integrated_tree,
            "current_recursive_level": level + 1
        }

    def structure_validator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """结构验证器"""
        logger.info("验证树结构一致性")
        
        def compare_structure(tree1: Dict[str, Any], tree2: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
            """比较两个树的结构是否相同"""
            if tree1["title"] != tree2["title"]:
                return False
            
            children1 = tree1.get("children", [])
            children2 = tree2.get("children", [])
            children1 = sorted(children1, key=lambda x: x["title"])
            children2 = sorted(children2, key=lambda x: x["title"])
            
            if len(children1) != len(children2):
                return False
            
            for c1, c2 in zip(children1, children2):
                if not compare_structure(c1, c2):
                    return False
            
            return True
        
        is_valid = compare_structure(state["simplified_tree"], state["beautified_tree"])
        
        if not is_valid:
            feedback = "树结构不一致，beautified_tree的title和children结构必须与simplified_tree完全相同"
        else:
            feedback = "PASS"
        
        return {"current_feedback": feedback}
    
    async def alias_description_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """别名和描述生成器（异步）"""
        logger.info("生成别名和描述")
        
        def extract_sub_trees(node: Dict[str, Any], parent: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
            """提取所有子树（节点+直接子节点）"""
            sub_trees = []
            
            # 构建当前子树
            sub_tree = {
                "title": node["title"],
                "relation": node.get("relation", ""),
                "labels": node.get("labels", []),
                "path": node.get("path", ""),
                "reference": node.get("reference", "")
            }
            
            if "children" in node:
                sub_tree["children"] = [
                    {
                        "title": child["title"],
                        "relation": child.get("relation", ""),
                        "labels": child.get("labels", [])
                    }
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            sub_trees.append(sub_tree)
            
            # 递归处理子节点
            if "children" in node:
                for child in node["children"]:
                    sub_trees.extend(extract_sub_trees(child, node))
            
            return sub_trees
        
        async def generate_alias_description(sub_tree: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """为单个子树生成别名和描述"""
            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_alias_description_design_prompt(
                sub_tree=sub_tree,
                field=state["field"]
            )
            
            response = await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)
            
            try:
                result = get_json_dict_res(response)
                return {
                    "title": sub_tree["title"],
                    "alias": result.get("alias", []),
                    "description": result.get("description", "")
                }
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                return {
                    "title": sub_tree["title"],
                    "alias": [],
                    "description": ""
                }
        
        # 获取完整树（包含所有信息）
        full_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
        
        # 提取所有子树
        all_sub_trees = extract_sub_trees(full_tree)
        
        # 异步生成所有别名和描述
        tasks = [generate_alias_description(sub_tree) for sub_tree in all_sub_trees]
        alias_descriptions = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        
        # 创建映射
        alias_desc_map = {ad["title"]: ad for ad in alias_descriptions}
        
        # 将别名和描述添加到beautified_tree
        def add_alias_description(node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """递归添加别名和描述"""
            if node["title"] in alias_desc_map:
                ad = alias_desc_map[node["title"]]
                node["alias"] = ad["alias"]
                node["description"] = ad["description"]
            
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    add_alias_description(child)
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        enhanced_tree = add_alias_description(state["beautified_tree"].copy())
        
        return {"beautified_tree": enhanced_tree}
    
    def final_tree_assembler_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """最终树组装器"""
        logger.info("组装最终树")
        
        # 获取所有需要的树
        beautified = state["beautified_tree"]
        full_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
        
        def merge_trees(beautified_node: Dict[str, Any], full_node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """合并beautified树和完整树的信息"""
            merged = {
                "title": beautified_node["title"],
                "alias": beautified_node.get("alias", []),
                "description": beautified_node.get("description", ""),
                "labels": beautified_node.get("labels", []),
                "relation": beautified_node.get("relation", ""),
                "node_id": full_node.get("node_id", ""),
                "path": full_node.get("path", ""),
                "reference": full_node.get("reference", ""),
                "source": full_node.get("source", {}),
                "search_query": full_node.get("search_query", "")
            }
            
            # 递归处理子节点
            if "children" in beautified_node:
                full_children = full_node.get("children", [])
                merged["children"] = []
                
                for b_child in beautified_node["children"]:
                    # 找到对应的full_node子节点
                    matching_full = None
                    for f_child in full_children:
                        if f_child["title"] == b_child["title"]:
                            matching_full = f_child
                            break
                    
                    if matching_full:
                        merged["children"].append(
                            merge_trees(b_child, matching_full)
                        )
            
            return merged
        
        final_tree = merge_trees(beautified, full_tree)
        
        # 保存最终树
        self.file_manager.save_tree(final_tree, "final_tree", state["field"])
        
        logger.info("知识树构建完成")
        
        return {"final_tree": final_tree}
    
    # ==================== 条件函数 ====================
    
    def check_base_tree_condition(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> str:
        """检查基础树是否需要改进"""
        if state["current_feedback"].get('status', "FAILED").upper() == "PASS" or int(state["current_feedback"].get("score", 0)) >= 60:

        elif state["react_iteration"] >= state.get("max_react_iterations", 3):

    def check_stage_transition(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> str:
        """检查阶段转换"""

        else:

    def check_recursive_condition(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> str:
        """检查是否继续递归"""
        current_level = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
        max_level = state.get("recursive_times", 2)
        
        if current_level < max_level:

                    node["children"] = [
                        map_references(child, chunks) 
                        for child in node["children"]
                    ]
                
                return node
            
            mapped_tree = map_references(state["base_tree"].copy(), state["chunks"])
            
            result = {"base_tree": mapped_tree}

    async def report_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """报告生成器（异步分块并发优化版）"""
        logger.info("生成研究报告（异步分块优化）")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            sem = asyncio.Semaphore(self.max_concurrency)
            level_default = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
            
            def _split_chunks(text: str, size: int, overlap: int) -> List[str]:
                """按字符窗口分块，带重叠"""
                text = text or ""
                n = len(text)
                if n <= size or size <= 0:
                    return [text] if text else []
                chunks = []
                start = 0
                while start < n:
                    end = min(n, start + size)
                    chunks.append(text[start:end])
                    if end >= n:
                        break
                    start = max(0, end - max(0, overlap))
                return chunks
            
            async def _llm_call(prompt: str) -> str:
                """异步LLM调用"""
                try:
                    return (await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)) or ""
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"LLM调用异常: {e}")
                    return ""
            
            async def _build_report_for_node(idx: int, result_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                """处理单个节点的报告生成"""
                node = result_data["node"]
                content = (result_data.get("cleaned_content") or "").strip()
                node_id = str(node.get("node_id", f"node_{idx}"))
                title = str(node.get("title", f"Leaf_{idx}"))
                
                if not content:
                    logger.warning(f"节点({title})内容为空，跳过生成")
                    return {"node": node, "report": "", "report_path": None, "error": "EMPTY_CONTENT"}
                
                # 检查缓存
                content_hash = hash_id(content)
                cache_key = (node_id, content_hash)
                
                if self.enable_cache and cache_key in self._report_cache:
                    cached_report, cached_path = self._report_cache[cache_key]
                    logger.debug(f"报告缓存命中: {title}")
                    return {
                        "node": node,
                        "report": cached_report,
                        "report_path": cached_path,
                        "cache_hit": True
                    }
                
                try:
                    async with sem:
                        # 分块处理
                        chunks = _split_chunks(content, self.chunk_chars, self.chunk_overlap)
                        
                        if len(chunks) <= 1:
                            # 短文本直接处理
                            prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_research_result_to_report_prompt(
                                cleaned_content=content,
                                field=state["field"],
                                path=node["path"],
                                leaf_node=title
                            )
                            report = await _llm_call(prompt)
                        else:
                            # Map-Reduce处理长文本
                            async def _map_chunk(chunk_text: str) -> str:
                                prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_research_result_to_report_prompt(
                                    cleaned_content=chunk_text,
                                    field=state["field"],
                                    path=node["path"],
                                    leaf_node=title
                                )
                                return await _llm_call(prompt)
                            
                            # 并发处理所有chunks
                            map_tasks = [_map_chunk(c) for c in chunks]
                            partials = await asyncio.gather(*map_tasks)
                            
                            # 合并子报告
                            partials = [p.strip() for p in partials if p and p.strip()]
                            if partials:
                                synth_prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_report_synthesis_prompt(
                                    partial_reports=partials,
                                    field=state["field"],
                                    path=node["path"],
                                    leaf_node=title
                                )
                                report = await _llm_call(synth_prompt)
                            else:
                                report = ""
                        
                        # 保存报告
                        if report:
                            report_path = await asyncio.to_thread(
                                self.file_manager.save_report,
                                report, title, node_id, level_default
                            )
                            
                            # 写入缓存
                            if self.enable_cache:
                                self._report_cache[cache_key] = (report, report_path)
                        else:
                            report_path = None
                        
                        return {
                            "node": node,
                            "report": report,
                            "report_path": report_path,
                            "cache_hit": False
                        }
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"生成报告失败：node={title}, error={e}")
                    return {"node": node, "report": "", "report_path": None, "error": str(e)}
            
            # 并发处理所有节点
            tasks = [_build_report_for_node(i, rd) for i, rd in enumerate(state.get("search_results", []))]
            results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if tasks else []
            
            # 保存状态
            result = {"reports": results}
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "report_generator")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            success_count = len([r for r in results if r.get("report")])
            cache_hits = len([r for r in results if r.get("cache_hit")])
            logger.info(f"报告生成完成，成功{success_count}/{len(results)}个，缓存命中{cache_hits}个，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"报告生成失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"报告生成失败: {e}"]}

                        "issues": ["EMPTY_REPORT"],
                        "message": "报告内容为空"
                    }
                    return {"node_id": node_id, "title": title, "feedback": feedback}
                
                prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_check_report_prompt(report_text)
                try:
                    async with sem:
                        resp = await _llm_call(prompt)
                    feedback = _normalize_feedback(resp)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"检查报告失败：{title}, error={e}")
                    feedback = {"status": "FAILED", "issues": ["EXCEPTION"], "message": str(e)}
                
                return {"node_id": node_id, "title": title, "feedback": feedback}
            
            # 并发检查所有报告
            tasks = [_check_one(i, rd) for i, rd in enumerate(reports)]
            results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True) if tasks else []
            
            # 汇总结果
            failed_items = []
            pass_cnt = 0
            
            for result in results:
                if isinstance(result, Exception):
                    logger.error(f"检查任务异常: {result}")

                status = result["feedback"].get("status", "FAILED")

                    pass_cnt += 1
                else:
                    failed_items.append({
                        "node_id": result["node_id"],
                        "node": result["title"],
                        "feedback": result["feedback"]
                    })
            
            total = len([r for r in results if not isinstance(r, Exception)])
            fail_cnt = total - pass_cnt
            
            # 返回JSON格式的反馈
            current_feedback_json = json.dumps(failed_items, ensure_ascii=False)
            
            result = {
                "current_feedback": current_feedback_json,
                "report_check_status": "PASS" if fail_cnt == 0 else "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
                "report_check_summary": {
                    "total": total,
                    "pass": pass_cnt,
                    "fail": fail_cnt
                }
            }
            
            # 保存状态
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "report_checker")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()

    async def report_improver_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """报告改进器（异步并发优化版）"""
        logger.info("改进报告（异步优化）")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            sem = asyncio.Semaphore(self.max_concurrency)
            level_default = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
            reports = state.get("reports", []) or []
            improved_reports = [dict(r) for r in reports]  # 深拷贝
            
            # 解析反馈
            raw_fb = state.get("current_feedback", "[]")
            feedback_list = []
            
            try:
                if isinstance(raw_fb, str):
                    feedback_list = json.loads(raw_fb) if raw_fb.strip() else []
                elif isinstance(raw_fb, list):

                else:
                    feedback_list = []
            except Exception:
                logger.warning("current_feedback解析失败，视为无反馈")
                feedback_list = []
            
            # 创建反馈映射
            fb_by_key = {}
            for item in feedback_list:
                node_title = str(item.get("node") or item.get("title") or "")
                node_id = str(item.get("node_id") or "")
                key = node_id or node_title
                if key:
                    fb_by_key[key] = item.get("feedback", {}) or {}
            
            if not fb_by_key:
                logger.info("无需改进的报告")
                return {
                    "reports": improved_reports,
                    "improvement_summary": {"total": len(reports), "improved": 0, "skipped": len(reports)}
                }
            
            async def _llm_call(prompt: str) -> str:
                try:
                    return (await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)) or ""
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"LLM调用异常（改进报告）: {e}")
                    return ""
            
            async def _improve_one(idx: int, rd: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[int, Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
                """改进单个报告"""
                node = rd.get("node", {}) or {}
                title = str(node.get("title", f"Leaf_{idx}"))
                node_id = str(node.get("node_id", f"node_{idx}"))
                key = node_id or title
                
                if key not in fb_by_key:
                    return idx, None, None  # 不需要改进
                
                feedback = fb_by_key[key]
                report_text = (rd.get("report") or "").strip()
                if not report_text:
                    return idx, None, "EMPTY_REPORT"
                
                prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_improve_report_prompt(report_text, feedback)
                
                try:
                    async with sem:
                        improved = await _llm_call(prompt)
                    improved = improved.strip() if improved else ""
                    if not improved:
                        return idx, None, "EMPTY_MODEL_OUTPUT"
                    
                    # 保存改进后的报告
                    try:
                        await asyncio.to_thread(
                            self.file_manager.save_report,
                            improved, title, node_id, level_default
                        )
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"保存改进报告失败：{title}, error={e}")
                    
                    return idx, improved, None
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"改进失败：{title}, error={e}")
                    return idx, None, str(e)
            
            # 并发改进
            tasks = [_improve_one(i, rd) for i, rd in enumerate(improved_reports)]
            results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if tasks else []
            
            improved_cnt = 0
            skipped_cnt = 0
            error_cnt = 0
            
            for idx, improved_text, err in results:
                if err:
                    error_cnt += 1
                    continue
                if improved_text is None:
                    skipped_cnt += 1
                    continue
                improved_reports[idx]["report"] = improved_text
                improved_cnt += 1
            
            # 可选复检
            residual_feedback_json = "[]"
            if self.recheck_after_improve and improved_cnt > 0:
                try:
                    # 只复检刚改进的报告
                    recheck_targets = [
                        improved_reports[idx]
                        for idx, improved_text, err in results
                        if (improved_text is not None and not err)
                    ]
                    
                    async def _recheck_one(rd: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                        node = rd.get("node", {}) or {}
                        title = str(node.get("title", ""))
                        node_id = str(node.get("node_id", ""))

                        status = str(fb.get("status", "FAILED")).upper()
                        if status not in ("PASS",):
                            return {"node_id": node_id, "node": title, "feedback": fb}
                        return {}
                    
                    re_tasks = [_recheck_one(rd) for rd in recheck_targets]
                    re_results = await asyncio.gather(*re_tasks, return_exceptions=True) if re_tasks else []
                    residual = [x for x in re_results if isinstance(x, dict) and x]
                    residual_feedback_json = json.dumps(residual, ensure_ascii=False)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"改进后复检异常: {e}")
            
            result = {
                "reports": improved_reports,
                "improvement_summary": {
                    "total": len(reports),
                    "improved": improved_cnt,
                    "skipped": skipped_cnt,
                    "errors": error_cnt
                },
                "residual_feedback_after_improve": residual_feedback_json
            }
            
            # 保存状态
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "report_improver")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            logger.info(f"报告改进完成，改进{improved_cnt}个，跳过{skipped_cnt}个，错误{error_cnt}个，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"报告改进失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"报告改进失败: {e}"]}
    
    def sub_tree_builder_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """子树构建器 - 修复版本（使用text_chunking逻辑处理报告）"""
        logger.info("为叶子节点构建子树")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            sub_trees = []
            
            for report_data in state["reports"]:
                node = report_data["node"]
                report = report_data["report"]
                
                if not report or not report.strip():
                    logger.warning(f"节点 {node.get('title', 'Unknown')} 的报告为空，跳过子树构建")
                    continue
                
                # 使用text_chunking_node的逻辑处理报告
                # 将报告按双换行符分割并编号
                chunks = report.split("\n\n")
                cleaned_chunks = []
                
                for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks, 1):
                    cleaned_chunk = chunk.strip()
                    if cleaned_chunk:
                        chunk_id = f"{i:03d}"
                        cleaned_chunks.append({
                            "id": chunk_id,
                            "text": cleaned_chunk
                        })
                
                # 创建编号文本
                numbered_text = "\n".join([f"[{c['id']}] {c['text']}" for c in cleaned_chunks])
                
                if not numbered_text.strip():
                    logger.warning(f"节点 {node.get('title', 'Unknown')} 处理后的编号文本为空")
                    continue
                
                # 使用编号文本生成子树
                prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_base_tree_prompt(
                    field=state["field"],
                    numbered_text=numbered_text
                )
                
                response = llm_util(prompt)
                
                try:
                    sub_tree = get_json_dict_res(response)
                    
                    # 处理子树：添加路径、ID、源信息等
                    sub_tree = self._process_sub_tree(sub_tree, node, report_data.get("report_path"))
                    
                    sub_trees.append({
                        "parent_node": node,
                        "sub_tree": sub_tree,
                        "numbered_text": numbered_text,
                        "chunks": cleaned_chunks
                    })
                    
                    logger.debug(f"为节点 {node.get('title', 'Unknown')} 构建了子树")
                    
                except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                    logger.error(f"子树JSON解析失败 for {node.get('title', 'Unknown')}: {e}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"子树构建失败 for {node.get('title', 'Unknown')}: {e}")
            
            result = {"sub_trees": sub_trees}
            
            # 保存状态
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "sub_tree_builder")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            logger.info(f"子树构建完成，成功构建{len(sub_trees)}个子树，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"子树构建失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"子树构建失败: {e}"]}
    
    def _process_sub_tree(self, sub_tree: Dict[str, Any], parent_node: Dict[str, Any], report_path: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """处理子树：添加必要的信息"""
        
        def process_node(node: Dict[str, Any], parent_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            # 添加路径
            node["path"] = f"{parent_path}->{node['title']}"
            
            # 添加节点ID
            node["node_id"] = hash_id(node["title"] + node["path"])
            
            # 添加源信息
            node["source"] = {
                "source_name": parent_node.get("source", {}).get("source_name", ""),
                "source_url": report_path or "",
                "source_content": node.get("reference", "")
            }
            
            # 添加搜索查询
            node["search_query"] = parent_node.get("search_query", "")
            
            # 递归处理子节点
            if "children" in node:
                node["children"] = [
                    process_node(child, node["path"])
                    for child in node["children"]
                ]
            
            return node
        
        return process_node(sub_tree, parent_node["path"])
    
    def tree_integrator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """树集成器"""
        logger.info("集成子树到主树")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            current_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
            
            def integrate_sub_trees(node: Dict[str, Any], sub_trees_map: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                """递归集成子树"""
                node_key = f"{node['title']}_{node['node_id']}"
                
                # 如果当前节点有对应的子树，替换其子节点
                if node_key in sub_trees_map:
                    sub_tree = sub_trees_map[node_key]
                    if "children" in sub_tree:
                        node["children"] = sub_tree["children"]
                        logger.debug(f"为节点 {node['title']} 集成了 {len(sub_tree['children'])} 个子节点")
                
                # 递归处理原有子节点
                elif "children" in node:
                    node["children"] = [
                        integrate_sub_trees(child, sub_trees_map)
                        for child in node["children"]
                    ]
                
                return node
            
            # 创建子树映射
            sub_trees_map = {}
            for sub_tree_data in state["sub_trees"]:
                parent = sub_tree_data["parent_node"]
                key = f"{parent['title']}_{parent['node_id']}"
                sub_trees_map[key] = sub_tree_data["sub_tree"]
            
            # 集成子树
            integrated_tree = integrate_sub_trees(current_tree.copy(), sub_trees_map)
            
            # 保存富化树
            level = state.get("current_recursive_level", 1)
            self.file_manager.save_tree(integrated_tree, f"rich_tree_level_{level}", state["field"])
            
            result = {
                "rich_tree": integrated_tree,
                "current_recursive_level": level + 1
            }
            
            # 保存状态
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "tree_integrator")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            logger.info(f"树集成完成，当前递归级别{level + 1}，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"树集成失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"树集成失败: {e}"]}

    def structure_validator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """结构验证器"""
        logger.info("验证树结构一致性")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            def compare_structure(tree1: Dict[str, Any], tree2: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
                """比较两个树的结构是否相同"""
                if tree1["title"] != tree2["title"]:
                    logger.debug(f"标题不匹配: {tree1['title']} vs {tree2['title']}")
                    return False
                
                children1 = tree1.get("children", [])
                children2 = tree2.get("children", [])
                
                if len(children1) != len(children2):
                    logger.debug(f"子节点数量不匹配: {len(children1)} vs {len(children2)}")
                    return False
                
                # 按标题排序比较
                children1 = sorted(children1, key=lambda x: x["title"])
                children2 = sorted(children2, key=lambda x: x["title"])
                
                for c1, c2 in zip(children1, children2):
                    if not compare_structure(c1, c2):
                        return False
                
                return True
            
            is_valid = compare_structure(state["simplified_tree"], state["beautified_tree"])
            
            if not is_valid:
                feedback = "树结构不一致，beautified_tree的title和children结构必须与simplified_tree完全相同"
                logger.warning("结构验证失败")
            else:
                feedback = "PASS"
                logger.debug("结构验证通过")
            
            result = {"current_feedback": feedback}
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            logger.info(f"结构验证完成，结果: {'通过' if is_valid else '失败'}，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"结构验证失败: {e}")
            return {"current_feedback": f"验证异常: {e}"}
    
    async def alias_description_generator_node(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """别名和描述生成器（异步优化版）"""
        logger.info("生成别名和描述（异步优化）")
        stage_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            sem = asyncio.Semaphore(self.max_concurrency)
            
            def extract_sub_trees(node: Dict[str, Any], parent: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
                """提取所有子树（节点+直接子节点）"""
                sub_trees = []
                
                # 构建当前子树
                sub_tree = {
                    "title": node["title"],
                    "relation": node.get("relation", ""),
                    "labels": node.get("labels", []),
                    "path": node.get("path", ""),
                    "reference": node.get("reference", "")
                }
                
                if "children" in node:
                    sub_tree["children"] = [
                        {
                            "title": child["title"],
                            "relation": child.get("relation", ""),
                            "labels": child.get("labels", [])
                        }
                        for child in node["children"]
                    ]
                
                sub_trees.append(sub_tree)
                
                # 递归处理子节点
                if "children" in node:
                    for child in node["children"]:
                        sub_trees.extend(extract_sub_trees(child, node))
                
                return sub_trees
            
            async def generate_alias_description(sub_tree: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                """为单个子树生成别名和描述"""
                async with sem:
                    prompt = self.prompt_factory.get_alias_description_design_prompt(
                        sub_tree=sub_tree,
                        field=state["field"]
                    )
                    
                    response = await asyncio.to_thread(llm_util, prompt)
                    
                    try:
                        result = get_json_dict_res(response)
                        return {
                            "title": sub_tree["title"],
                            "alias": result.get("alias", []),
                            "description": result.get("description", "")
                        }
                    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                        logger.error(f"别名描述JSON解析失败 for {sub_tree['title']}: {e}")
                        return {
                            "title": sub_tree["title"],
                            "alias": [],
                            "description": ""
                        }
            
            # 获取完整树
            full_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
            
            # 提取所有子树
            all_sub_trees = extract_sub_trees(full_tree)
            
            # 异步生成所有别名和描述
            tasks = [generate_alias_description(sub_tree) for sub_tree in all_sub_trees]
            alias_descriptions = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
            
            # 处理结果
            alias_desc_map = {}
            for result in alias_descriptions:
                if isinstance(result, Exception):
                    logger.error(f"别名描述生成异常: {result}")
                    continue
                alias_desc_map[result["title"]] = result
            
            # 将别名和描述添加到beautified_tree
            def add_alias_description(node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                """递归添加别名和描述"""
                if node["title"] in alias_desc_map:
                    ad = alias_desc_map[node["title"]]
                    node["alias"] = ad["alias"]
                    node["description"] = ad["description"]
                
                if "children" in node:
                    node["children"] = [
                        add_alias_description(child)
                        for child in node["children"]
                    ]
                
                return node
            
            enhanced_tree = add_alias_description(state["beautified_tree"].copy())
            
            result = {"beautified_tree": enhanced_tree}
            
            # 保存状态
            updated_state = {**state, **result}
            self.state_manager.save_state(updated_state, "alias_description_generator")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - stage_start).total_seconds()
            success_count = len(alias_desc_map)
            logger.info(f"别名描述生成完成，成功{success_count}/{len(all_sub_trees)}个，耗时{processing_time:.2f}秒")
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"别名描述生成失败: {e}")
            return {"errors": state.get("errors", []) + [f"别名描述生成失败: {e}"]}

        try:
            # 获取所有需要的树
            beautified = state["beautified_tree"]
            full_tree = state.get("rich_tree") or state["base_tree"]
            
            def merge_trees(beautified_node: Dict[str, Any], full_node: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                """合并beautified树和完整树的信息"""
                merged = {
                    "title": beautified_node["title"],
                    "alias": beautified_node.get("alias", []),
                    "description": beautified_node.get("description", ""),
                    "labels": beautified_node.get("labels", []),
                    "relation": beautified_node.get("relation", ""),
                    "node_id": full_node.get("node_id", ""),
                    "path": full_node.get("path", ""),
                    "reference": full_node.get("reference", ""),
                    "source": full_node.get("source", {}),
                    "search_query": full_node.get("search_query", "")
                }
                
                # 递归处理子节点
                if "children" in beautified_node:
                    full_children = full_node.get("children", [])
                    merged["children"] = []
                    
                    for b_child in beautified_node["children"]:
                        # 找到对应的full_node子节点
                        matching_full = None
                        for f_child in full_children:
                            if f_child["title"] == b_child["title"]:
                                matching_full = f_child
                                break
                        
                        if matching_full:
                            merged["children"].append(
                                merge_trees(b_child, matching_full)
                            )
                        else:

                    return "continue"
                else:

    def check_structure_condition(self, state: KnowledgeTreeState) -> str:
        """检查结构是否需要修复"""
        try:

                return "continue"

            initial_state = None
            start_node = "text_chunking"

                    saved_state.update({
